note: The core is Fuse, the Free Unix Spectrum Emulator (GPL-2.0-or-later), with libspectrum (GPL-2.0-or-later) and zlib (Zlib licence), built with this repository's patches (GPL-2.0-or-later) and integration (MIT). The program is distributed under the GPL version 2 or later. Inside Fuse are Blip_Buffer and the SNES NTSC filter by Shay Green (LGPL-2.1-or-later) and scalers from ScummVM (GPL-2.0-or-later). The package also contains the ROMs of the machines that Fuse itself is distributed with, built into the core: the ZX Spectrum 48K, 128, +2, +2A/+3 and Timex TC2048 ROMs (copyright Amstrad, who allow their distribution but retain the copyright; they may not be sold on their own), the Timex TC2068 ROMs (derived from Amstrad's, Timex's changes in the public domain), the +3e ROMs (derived from Amstrad's, the changes copyright Garry Lancaster) and the ZX Spectrum SE's OpenSE BASIC (GPL-2.0-or-later). Fuse's roms/README.copyright, carried in this package, says so for each file. The Pentagon's and the Scorpion's own ROMs are not in the package: the user supplies them. The package contains no game.
